description: Foundation: light-mode design tokens, font wiring (incl. new Fraunces serif), and app shell. This defines the token/font vocabulary that every later feature consumes, so it must come first. Grounded finding: globals.css has NO @theme block today, so the next/font variables declared in layout.tsx are not wired into Tailwind and font-sans currently resolves to the apple-system fallback — fixing that is part of this feature.
steps: In app/globals.css: rewrite the :root custom properties from the dark palette to the light palette (see context.json palette): --background #faf9f5, --foreground #1f1915, --card/--popover #ffffff (foreground #1f1915), --primary #20808d with --primary-foreground #ffffff, --secondary/--muted/--accent to warm neutral (#f5f4ef) with muted foreground #6b675f, --destructive #c25450, --border/--input #e7e5e0, --ring #20808d.

In app/globals.css: replace the hardcoded dark body rule — keep `overflow: hidden`, set background-color to the cream canvas and color to warm charcoal; it is fine to switch body font-family to use var(--font-sans) so Lexend applies, or leave the apple-system fallback and rely on the html font-sans utility — but ensure the themed sans is actually used.

In app/globals.css: add a Tailwind v4 `@theme` block (CSS-first config; there is no tailwind.config file) that maps `--font-sans: var(--font-lexend-sans)`, `--font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono)`, and `--font-serif: var(--font-fraunces)`. Optionally also expose the accent/surface/border/status colors as `--color-*` theme entries so utility classes can reference them, but literal class swaps in later FEATs are acceptable too.

In app/globals.css: retheme the ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb colors from cold slate rgba to a warm-neutral low-opacity tone that reads on a light canvas. DO NOT yet touch the .osm-dark-tiles / .leaflet-container / .leaflet-popup-* rules — those belong to FEAT-004.

In app/layout.tsx: import `Fraunces` from `next/font/google` alongside the existing Lexend and Geist_Mono imports; instantiate it with `{ variable: "--font-fraunces", subsets: ["latin"] }` following the exact existing pattern (confirmed valid against node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/13-fonts.md). Append `${fraunces.variable}` to the existing <html> className string next to lexendSans.variable and geistMono.variable. Do not remove or rename the existing fonts; do not change metadata or the component signature.

In app/page.tsx: change ONLY styling classes — root div from `bg-slate-950 text-slate-100` to the cream canvas + charcoal text (e.g. `bg-[#faf9f5] text-[#1f1915]`), keep `flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden font-sans select-none`. Change <main> from `bg-slate-900` to a light map backdrop (e.g. `bg-stone-100`). Leave all other classes, all props passed to child components, and all JSX structure/state untouched.
acceptance_criteria: app/globals.css :root uses the light palette and includes a @theme block mapping --font-sans/--font-mono/--font-serif to the next/font variables.
body keeps overflow:hidden and renders cream background with charcoal text.
app/layout.tsx imports Fraunces via next/font/google with variable --font-fraunces and the variable is present on the <html> className; Lexend and Geist Mono remain.
app/page.tsx root is cream + charcoal and main is a light backdrop; no props/state/structure changed.
`bun run build` completes without errors (this validates the @theme block and the Fraunces import).
verification: Run `bun run lint` from the website directory and confirm it exits 0.
Run `bun run build` from the website directory and confirm it completes without errors (bun path if not on PATH: /Users/zeph/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/latest/bin/bun).
findings:
Foundation complete. lint exit 0, build no errors.

FONT UTILITIES (now wired via @theme block in globals.css):
- `font-sans` -> Lexend (--font-lexend-sans). Also set as body font-family default.
- `font-mono` -> Geist Mono (--font-geist-mono). Use for IDs/UUIDs/coords.
- `font-serif` -> Fraunces (--font-fraunces), NEW. Use ONLY for brand/title + large display headings (e.g. sidebar brand). Fraunces imported in app/layout.tsx and ${fraunces.variable} is on <html> className alongside the existing two.

CSS :root TOKENS (light palette, read by var(--...) consumers like body + future leaflet): --background #faf9f5, --foreground #1f1915, --card/--popover #ffffff, --primary #20808d (--primary-foreground #fff), --secondary/--muted/--accent #f5f4ef (muted-foreground #6b675f), --destructive #c25450, --border/--input #e7e5e0, --ring #20808d.

TAILWIND COLOR UTILITIES exposed via @theme (--color-* -> usable as bg-*/text-*/border-* etc.):
- canvas (#faf9f5), surface (#ffffff), surface-warm (#fdfbfa), surface-tint (#f5f4ef)
- border-warm (#e7e5e0), border-strong (#d6d3cc)
- charcoal (#1f1915), muted-foreground (#6b675f), faint (#8a857c)
- accent-teal (#20808d), accent-teal-deep (#016a71)
- status-green (#4f9d69), status-amber (#c08a2d), status-red (#c25450)
- signal-red (#d1584f), signal-amber (#d99a2b), signal-green (#4f9d69)
These are OPTIONAL conveniences; later FEATs may use either these named utilities (e.g. bg-canvas, text-charcoal, border-border-warm, text-accent-teal) or literal arbitrary values (e.g. bg-[#faf9f5]). page.tsx used literal arbitrary values (bg-[#faf9f5] text-[#1f1915]) and main uses bg-stone-100.

SCROLLBAR thumb retheme to warm rgba(31,25,21,0.15) / hover 0.3.

NOT TOUCHED (reserved for FEAT-004): .osm-dark-tiles, .leaflet-container, .leaflet-popup-* rules in globals.css still carry dark values.
